summary: Iteration 3 full-stack testing of 4 new features + sizing + regression. Backend: 12/12 iter3 feature tests PASS and 15/15 iter2 regression tests PASS (27/27 total). Frontend: all iter3 UI selectors render & behave correctly at 1280x800 and 390x844; no horizontal overflow at either breakpoint.

backend_feature_results.voice: POST /api/voice accepts multipart wav upload; message created with attachment.is_voice=true; status transitions out of 'translating' (sent or translation_failed when transcript empty); recipient GET /api/messages/{chat_id} returns the voice message with is_voice=true and (when transcript non-empty) is_translated=true in English. Non-member upload -> 403.
backend_feature_results.search: GET /api/messages/{chat_id}/search?q=... matches BOTH original_text and viewer-language translation. Verified: giulia(it) finds a nonsense IT marker in original; james(en) finds 'banana' only present in the English translation. Empty q -> []. Non-member -> 403.
backend_feature_results.group_info: PUT /api/chats/{chat_id}/info updates name/description/avatar for admin; response includes display_avatar + description. Sidebar GET /api/chats reflects the change for other members. Non-admin member -> 403. Non-member -> 403.
backend_feature_results.block_report: James blocks Giulia -> Giulia POST /api/messages to direct chat returns 403. After unblock -> 200. POST /api/users/{id}/report returns {ok:true}. GET /api/users/blocked reflects blocked ids.

frontend_results.record_voice_button: visible when message-input is empty; replaced by send-message-button when text present (data-testid toggle works).
frontend_results.voice_player: MessageBubble renders <audio data-testid=voice-player-{id}> when attachment.is_voice=true (code verified; browser mic not available for live recording in automation).
frontend_results.search_panel: search-messages-button opens message-search-panel; message-search-input live-searches; search-match-{id} items render (2 matches for 'handsome' on James's en side — matches translation of Giulia's Italian preview message, proving translation-column search works end-to-end).
frontend_results.info_panel_block_report: On direct chat, block-user-button + report-user-button present; report-user-button opens report-dialog with report-reason-input + submit-report-button.
frontend_results.group_info_display: Group header + sidebar reflect updated name ('TEST_ITER3_RENAMED') and description ('A test group for iter3'); non-admin (James) does NOT see edit-group-button (correct per spec).
frontend_results.sizing: At 1280x800 documentElement scrollWidth==clientWidth (no overflow). At 390x844 scrollWidth==clientWidth, mobile-back-button present. No clipping observed in sidebar items, bubbles, or input.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 857 lines (>700 soft limit) — split into routers (auth, chats, messages, voice, moderation).

send_voice: transcription errors are swallowed with only a logger.warning; the resulting message has empty original_text and status 'sent' with no translation. Consider surfacing a 'transcription_failed' status so UI can show a retry affordance (currently only translation_failed is a user-visible state).
send_voice: no file-size cap enforced server-side (OpenAI Whisper limit is 25MB). A huge upload would be read fully into memory before the 413. Add Content-Length / UploadFile size guard.
search_messages: query uses case-insensitive regex but does not escape regex metacharacters in q (e.g. a user searching '.*' would match everything, '[' would raise regex error). Should re.escape(q).
update_group_info allows setting 'avatar' to any arbitrary URL string without validation — users could set a hostile external URL. Consider restricting to /api/files/{id} internal URLs.
block_user does not prevent sending in direction A->B when B blocked A? Actually it checks BOTH sides (correct), good.
WebSocket occasionally closes before established right after login (console warning). Not blocking features (REST fallback works) but worth checking the WS lifecycle on first mount.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ITER3 group (renamed to TEST_ITER3_RENAMED) with Giulia(admin)+James; plus a few throwaway strangers via /api/auth/register (prefixed) for 403 tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend iter3 tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_features.py. Run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -q`. For voice, automation generates a synthetic WAV (Whisper usually produces empty transcript on tone — expected). Translation is live via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; expect ~3-6s latency, use _wait_msg helper. The James<->Giulia direct chat is resolved canonically via POST /api/chats/direct/{other_id}.
